description: Android, Chrome and web development with Google Developer Knowledge MCP: android-compose (Kotlin, Compose, Gradle, navigation, performance, testing), chrome-web (MV3, Web Store, Baseline) and google-developer-knowledge (live docs, skill discovery and auth troubleshooting).

interface.longDescription: Android/Kotlin/Compose and Chrome/web development. Use Google Developer Knowledge for current official docs, targeted skill discovery and connection troubleshooting. android-compose covers architecture, Gradle, navigation, testing, performance, security, widgets and Media3; chrome-web covers MV3, Web Store, Baseline and extension checks. Cloud/Gemini operations live in the separate Google Dev Kit. Personal toolkit maintained by travnie; not an official Google plugin.
